title: Katherine Johnson at NASA Langley
alt: Katherine Johnson, smiling, sits at her desk holding a pencil, with a desk machine and a box of index cards beside her and sheets of handwritten figures in front of her; a large picture of the Moon hangs on the wall behind her.
